rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Oh...? It seems there's a force that's broken through our defenses and made it here.
rows.display_text:
「Oh...? It seems there's a force that's
broken through our defenses and made it
here.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: A suicide assault squad, is it. Not bad at all.
rows.display_text:
「A suicide assault squad, is it. Not bad
at all.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: Then let's smash that last hope of theirs to pieces.
rows.display_text:
「Then let's smash that last hope of
theirs to pieces.」

rows.speaker: Haman
rows.en: Don't underestimate them. The strength of those driven into a corner can sometimes defy imagination.
rows.display_text:
「Don't underestimate them. The strength
of those driven into a corner can
sometimes defy imagination.」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Then I shall hope for it -- that someone worthy of facing this Turn X has come!
rows.display_text:
「Then I shall hope for it -- that
someone worthy of facing this Turn X has
come!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Come, warriors! Give me some entertainment!
rows.display_text:
「Come, warriors! Give me some
entertainment!」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: To think they mean to take us down with a force this size.
rows.display_text:
「To think they mean to take us down
with a force this size.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: But I won't hold back. Anyone who gets in our way gets completely erased.
rows.display_text:
「But I won't hold back. Anyone who gets
in our way gets completely erased.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Give it five minutes and the fighting around us will be settled. I'll keep you company until then.
rows.display_text:
「Give it five minutes and the fighting
around us will be settled. I'll keep you
company until then.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: In these five minutes... you'll come to despair at your own powerlessness.
rows.display_text:
「In these five minutes... you'll come to
despair at your own powerlessness.」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: Enemy commander confirmed shot down! This is our victory!
rows.display_text:
「Enemy commander confirmed shot down!
This is our victory!」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: Everyone, you did wonderfully. That's what I'd expect from an assault squad made of our elites.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, you did wonderfully. That's
what I'd expect from an assault squad
made of our elites.」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: Now, let's head home. Everyone's waiting for you all.
rows.display_text:
「Now, let's head home. Everyone's waiting
for you all.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Impossible...! That the O and I would fall!?
rows.display_text:
「Impossible...! That the O and I would
fall!?」

rows.speaker: Haman
rows.en: Ngh...! To think they had this much strength in them!
rows.display_text:
「Ngh...! To think they had this much
strength in them!」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Tch! Is it going to end here!?
rows.display_text: 「Tch! Is it going to end here!?」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: Our war isn't over! I won't let it end!
rows.display_text: 「Our war isn't over! I won't let it end!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Ha ha ha ha ha ha, what a fine battle! I'll give you my praise!!
rows.display_text:
「Ha ha ha ha ha ha, what a fine battle!
I'll give you my praise!!」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: T-the assault squad has been wiped out!
rows.display_text:
「T-the assault squad has been wiped
out!」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: The operation's a failure... This is our defeat...
rows.display_text:
「The operation's a failure... This is our
defeat...」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: C-Captain! If we keep fighting like this, all that awaits us is annihilation!
rows.display_text:
「C-Captain! If we keep fighting like
this, all that awaits us is annihilation!」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: This makes the operation a failure. It's our defeat...
rows.display_text:
「This makes the operation a failure. It's
our defeat...」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: Arthur, what's the enemy's situation?
rows.display_text: 「Arthur, what's the enemy's situation?」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: Defense forces are deployed around the perimeter. The core of their strength is at the very innermost point.
rows.display_text:
「Defense forces are deployed around the
perimeter. The core of their strength is
at the very innermost point.」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: So that's where Paptimus Scirocco, Haman Karn, the Frost brothers, and Gym Ghingnham are.
rows.display_text:
「So that's where Paptimus Scirocco,
Haman Karn, the Frost brothers, and Gym
Ghingnham are.」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: Beyond that, elite units from every faction are guarding them as well.
rows.display_text:
「Beyond that, elite units from every
faction are guarding them as well.」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: ...It can't be helped. We'll launch a single-point breakthrough.
rows.display_text:
「...It can't be helped. We'll launch a
single-point breakthrough.」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: T-then...!?

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: We commit the entire fleet to send an assault force straight into the enemy's innermost stronghold... That's the only way to break this open.
rows.display_text:
「We send the whole fleet's assault force
straight at the enemy's core -- it's our
only way through.」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: But according to our calculations, at most eight squads could possibly reach the innermost point!
rows.display_text:
「But according to our calculations, at
most eight squads could possibly reach
the innermost point!」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: We're doing it anyway. To win.
rows.display_text: 「We're doing it anyway. To win.」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: All ships and units, back up the assault squad! We're staking our fate on those eight squads!
rows.display_text:
「All ships and units, back up the assault
squad! We're staking our fate on those
eight squads!」
